body:
After globs were added to the cli input in 5a599c70a98eaed0d43a8f28690921ef4ad0702d, my command to lint rule docs has broken:

```
DEBUG=eslint* node_modules/.bin/eslint --plugin markdown --no-eslintrc --config conf/rule-doc-config.json docs/rules/quote-props.md
  eslint:cli Running on files +0ms
  eslint:config Using command line config conf/rule-doc-config.json +3ms
  eslint:cli-engine Linting complete in: 3ms +10ms

/home/ian/Local_code/eslint/eslint/docs/rules/quote-props.md
  0:0  warning  File ignored because of your .eslintignore file. Use --no-ignore to override

✖ 1 problem (0 errors, 1 warning)
```

Compare to my output if I revert to the commit prior to globs being added:

```
▶ git reset --hard 37bb3159f748463861ba9aadf704e76af3c2537d
HEAD is now at 37bb315 Merge pull request #3518 from ev0rtex/update-expression-rule-logic

▶ DEBUG=eslint* node_modules/.bin/eslint --plugin markdown --no-eslintrc --config conf/rule-doc-config.json docs/rules/quote-props.md
  eslint:cli Running on files +0ms
  eslint:config Using command line config conf/rule-doc-config.json +3ms
  eslint:cli-engine Processing docs/rules/quote-props.md +10ms
  eslint:cli-engine Linting docs/rules/quote-props.md +1ms
  eslint:config Constructing config for /home/ian/Local_code/eslint/eslint/docs/rules/quote-props.md +0ms
  eslint:config Not using .eslintrc or package.json files +0ms
  eslint:config Merging command line config file +1ms
  eslint:config Merging command line environment settings +0ms
  eslint:config Merging command line plugins +0ms
  eslint:cli-engine Load plugin markdown +4ms

docs/rules/quote-props.md
    7:20  error  Unexpected token ;
  130:6   error  Unexpected string

✖ 2 problems (2 errors, 0 warnings)
```

Something appears to have changed in how files are determined to be ignored.  Furthermore, if I follow the warning's advice and add `--no-ignore`, the warning is not shown, but the file is still not linted:

```
▶ DEBUG=eslint* node_modules/.bin/eslint --plugin markdown --no-ignore --no-eslintrc --config conf/rule-doc-config.json docs/rules/quote-props.md
  eslint:cli Running on files +0ms
  eslint:config Using command line config conf/rule-doc-config.json +2ms
  eslint:cli-engine Linting complete in: 2ms +9ms
```
